key_values.canonical_stance: The disaster is best attributed to intense localized rainfall that saturated steep coastal slopes, causing compound landslides and flooding and requiring priority attention to settled slopes, buildings, roads, and access lifelines.
forbidden_claims: the answer requires exact casualty counts
burn-scar runoff, heat stress, or wind damage is the dominant mechanism
the hazard should be treated as spatially uniform across the whole region
gridded products exactly reproduce the public point rainfall total everywhere

notes: Off-event gridded precipitation, point weather, WorldPop, dNBR, and AlphaEarth products are not used in this ground truth.
The official answer path uses the event anchor and NASA Earth Observatory report text.

criteria.description: Identifies rainfall-triggered compound flooding and landsliding, and assigns a localized steep coastal community and lifeline response priority.
criteria.name: Correct mechanism and response priority
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for identifying heavy-rain flooding or landslides without the compound cascade, or for naming the compound mechanism but missing the localized lifeline priority.

criteria.description: Uses 680 mm in 24 hours, a 4-day event window, and a 5-day post-event image lag.
criteria.name: Report-supported numeric anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for two of the three numeric anchors or for correct values with unclear provenance.

criteria.description: Counts the four rain-saturation signals: torrential rain, 680 mm in a day, saturated soils/hillslopes, and high seasonal rainfall plus steep slopes.
criteria.name: Rainfall-saturation process signals
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for two or three correctly identified signals.

criteria.description: Counts the four terrain/impact signals: hilly or coastal municipality, homes/infrastructure impacts, destroyed buildings, and blocked highway SP-55/BR-101.
criteria.name: Infrastructure and access signals
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for two or three correctly identified impact/access signals.

criteria.description: Explains the causal sequence from intense localized rain to soil saturation, slope failure, flooding, and infrastructure or access impacts.
criteria.name: Physical impact chain
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a correct but incomplete chain.

criteria.description: Rejects burn-scar runoff, heat stress, wind damage, and spatially uniform regional hazard as weaker explanations.
criteria.name: Rejection of competing mechanisms
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for rejecting only some alternatives.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and avoids unsupported exact casualty claims or gridded-product precision claims.
criteria.name: Format and uncertainty discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a mostly clear answer with minor JSON formatting issues.
